text: John built Sokka Map. It turns TikTok food videos into places on your map. He posted nineteen TikToks. His most viewed one: nine thousand views... and six likes.
The app works. The videos don't. So what should he actually show?
He describes his app to Angle. One sentence.
Angle searches inside millions of videos with Oriane: what they show, say, and write on screen. Codex reads the frames and filters the noise.
One minute later: three creative directions, each backed by real videos people engaged with.
Every idea traces back to its source. This city guide, with forty-three thousand views, shows its map at second twenty-six.
Then Angle turns it into a storyboard he can shoot tonight. You saved the food video. Now you're hungry. Where's the restaurant?
Angle. Find your next video in the ones that already work.
